html:
Question 2
?

Austin's average monthly profit has been decreasing at a rate of 6% every year. If he initially recorded an average monthly profit of $58000, then which function correctly represents p(t), Austin's average monthly profit since the start of the decline?

a
p(t)=58000⋅(0.94)t
b
p(t)=58000⋅(0.6)t
c
p(t)=58000⋅(0.96)t
d
p(t)=58000⋅(0.06)t
e
p(t)=58000⋅(0.4)t
Submit
